## What's changed

- Match the Background Blur title and description to the other General settings: 18 px titles and 14 px descriptions, using the same theme font.
- Align the Background Blur text with the top of its row, matching neighboring settings.
- Let the row grow when its description wraps in a narrow window.

## Validation

- Release build and all 15 CTest suites, including settings QML validation.
- Installer checks and the real Quickshell connectivity lifecycle checks.

## Installation

Update the existing Arch Linux / AUR package:

```sh
paru -S tide-island
```

For a source installation, download `tide-island-source.tar.xz` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the checksum, extract the source, and run `./install.sh`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/enhaoswen/Tide-island/compare/1.0.45...1.0.46
